title: ジャパンカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: A-all right, then! I suppose I'll see you on the track!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I trust you won't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Right! Um… I'll be going, then!
choice_data_list: Is she racing with you today?
Is she racing with you today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. She intends to attempt the Classics this year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Her performance of late has been a sight to behold. And she even came to personally wish me well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: When I was young, I used to greet the older students in the same way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Back then, practicing with my elders helped me achieve greater successes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now that I am the elder, I hope to inspire by example.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're not getting overconfident?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What, are you worried she'll catch me by surprise?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let me ask you, Trainer—do you believe I would underestimate an opponent just because they were younger?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then that is all we shall say about that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Besides, it is the place of the strong to teach budding racers the taste of defeat. I am only doing my duty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, I believe it's time for the Emperor to get to work.
